name: Allegro MicroSystems, LLC
old_description: Here are just a few of the ways we’ve been helping customers around the world innovate with purpose since 1990.
about:
Allegro MicroSystems, LLC is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan. The company traces its origins to 1990, when it began developing semiconductor solutions for sensing and power applications. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed in the provided sources.

The company designs and manufactures mixed-signal integrated circuits, including Hall-effect current sensors, brushless DC motor controllers, and automotive-grade power management ICs (PMICs) that meet ASIL-D safety standards. Its product portfolio emphasizes ultra-low primary conductor resistance (50 µΩ) for high efficiency and thermal reliability. Scale metrics such as facility size, headcount, or annual volume are not specified in the available information.

Allegro serves a global customer base across automotive, industrial, e-mobility, clean energy, automation, robotics, data center, and smart factory sectors. The company notes that its components are used by virtually all major global automotive manufacturers, as well as in energy infrastructure and advanced robotics applications.

Allegro states its mission is to lead the world toward a safer, more sustainable, and autonomous future. The company highlights its 'innovation with purpose' philosophy and points to recognition such as the Nexteer Automotive 2023 Superior Customer Service Award as evidence of its customer-focused approach.
